```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run ESLint
      run: npx eslint .

    - name: Run Prettier
      run: npx prettier --check .

    - name: Compile TypeScript
      run: tsc --noEmit

    - name: Run tests
      run: npm test

    - name: Check test coverage
      run: |
        npx cypress run --headless --record --key ${{ secrets.CYPRESS_RECORD_KEY }}
        npx codecov

  pre-commit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run pre-commit hooks
      run: npx husky add .husky/pre-commit "npm test"
      env:
        HUSKY_GIT_PARAMS: ${{ github.event.inputs.GIT_PARAMS }}

  ci-documentation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Generate documentation
      run: npm run docs:generate

    - name: Commit and push documentation
      run: |
        git config --global user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
        git config --global user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
        git add docs
        git commit -m "chore(docs): update generated documentation"
        git push origin main
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a comprehensive CI/CD pipeline for the `multica-ai/multica` repository. It includes steps for building the project, running ESLint, Prettier, TypeScript compilation, tests, and checking test coverage. Additionally, it sets up a pre-commit hook using Husky to run tests before committing changes. The workflow also includes a step to generate and commit documentation.
